newsitem.title: USA: Boston Ed says Pilgrim unit at full power.
newsitem.headline: Boston Ed says Pilgrim unit at full power.

text.p: Boston Edison Co's 670 megawatt Pilgrim nuclear power plant was again operating at full capacity Thursday, ending a shutdown for repairs that began Sept 17, the company said Thursday.
"We're back at 100 pecent," said company spokeswoman Carol Wightman.
The unit was shut after a leak was detected at a set of heat exchangers in a reactor building. The company said it also carried out additional maintenance during the outage.
The Pilgrim plant is scheduled to shut for 35 days beginning Feb 1, 1997 for refueling and maintenance.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
